collisionCodes.water: blocks walking (deep water / ink); future boats may pass
collisionCodes.ledge_s: walkable; can be entered only moving south (hop down); blocks north/east/west entry
collisionCodes.ledge_e: walkable; can be entered only moving east
collisionCodes.ledge_w: walkable; can be entered only moving west
collisionCodes.pit: walking in drops the actor to the floor below (map defines the target); blocks AI
collisionCodes.counter: blocks movement, but talk/interact reaches across it (shop counters)

cliff.note: legend ids cliff_top / cliff_face; faces sit directly below the top

archive.note: legend ids archive_top / archive_face; face 1-3 rows below the top; the top fill is flat #14101e (void) inside a stone cap

archive_roots.note: legend ids archive_roots_top / archive_roots_face; the old root-choked earth fill under the same cap and face as archive

interior.note: legend ids interior_top / interior_face; faces are normally 2 rows tall

interior_wood.note: legend ids interior_wood_top / interior_wood_face; faces are normally 2 rows tall

interior_stone.note: legend ids interior_stone_top / interior_stone_face; faces are normally 2 rows tall

shelf_moving.note: slides along its rails when a switch fires; footprint moves with it

push_block.note: movable; draw at its tile, slide 16 px per push

pillar.note: free-standing column, 2 tiles tall; capital row overhead

door_key_closed.note: set into a 2-tile wall face; cells (0,0) and (1,0) are the doorway

door_key_open.note: set into a 2-tile wall face; cells (0,0) and (1,0) are the doorway

door_locked_closed.note: set into a 2-tile wall face; cells (0,0) and (1,0) are the doorway

door_locked_open.note: set into a 2-tile wall face; cells (0,0) and (1,0) are the doorway

hearth.note: top 2 rows overlap a 2-row wall face; bottom row is the hearthstone
